description: Use to stop one Watch + Alert watch that was started with your RugRadar credit key; pass its watch_id (from watch_token or list_watches) and the same key (api_key or header X-RugRadar-Key). Alerts stop right away and the watch cannot be restarted. No refund: credits spent on the watch are not returned, even if hours remain. Free to call. Cancelling an already cancelled or expired watch returns its current status and changes nothing. A watch started with a different key, or paid per-call with x402, returns not_found.

api_key.description: RugRadar credit key that started the watch (or header X-RugRadar-Key)

watch_id.description: Watch id (w_...) from watch_token or list_watches

name: cancel_watch

outputSchema.description: Success fields on a paid/authorized call, or error/payment_required fields. Additional properties may be present.

error.description: payment_required, bad_input, or a failure code

payWith.description: x402 payment requirement for the HTTP route, plus credit-key instructions when those apply

priceUsd.description: USDC price to pay when error is payment_required

refunded.description: true when a credit was taken and then returned because the call failed

title: Cancel a Token Watch
